explanation: This test only verifies that the FX rate is locked at the initiation of the top-up (fx_lock). It does not test that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited (credit_before_debit), nor does it test the rollback behavior on provider callback timeout (timeout_rollback), nor the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000 (dual_approval).
missingAssertions: Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Verify transaction rollback occurs if provider callback times out after 5 seconds
Verify top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the funding source is debited before the destination wallet is credited would not be caught, as the test does not verify the order of these operations. Also, a bug where the transaction is not rolled back after a timeout would not be detected, nor would a bug where top-ups above SGD 10,000 do not require second-owner approval.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify full top-up transaction behavior including FX rate lock, credit before debit, timeout rollback, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Initiate top-up of USD 100 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify FX rate used matches the recorded rate
Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Simulate provider callback timeout after 5 seconds and verify transaction rollback with no changes to wallet or funding source
Verify that second business owner approval is required before settlement
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; transaction rolls back on provider callback timeout with no side effects; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement
